entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The present transfer petition has been filed under Section 407 of the Code of Criminal Procedure
for transfer of the proceedings arising out of Dhanwar P.S. Case No.274 of 2020, corresponding to
G.R. No.833 of 2021, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate - 1 st Class, Giridih, to any
competent court at Bokaro.
3.  It appears that the the parties are related by marriage, which has been solemnized in the year 2018, as per the Hindu Rites.

The wife/ petitioner has lodged an F.I.R against O.P. No.02/ husband being Dhanwar P.S. Case No.274 of 2020, corresponding to G.R. No.833 of 2021 under Sections 323/ 504/ 506/ 34/ 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

Pooja Kumari Aged About 25 Years Wife Of ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29472787/
1

It further appears that the police after investigation has submitted charge-sheet to which cognizance has been taken by the court concerned under Sections 498A/ 323 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and accordingly, charge has been framed on 24.06.2021 under the above sections.
It also appears that the prosecution evidence is at advance stage and five witnesses have already been examined.
The only ground taken in the present transfer petition by the petitioner/ wife is difficulty.
Difficulty cannot be a ground for transfer of the case.
5. Considering the stage of trial, I am not inclined to transfer the Dhanwar P.S. Case No.274 of 2020, corresponding to G.R. No.833 of 2021.
Accordingly, the present transfer petition stands dismissed.
6. Pending interlocutory application, if any, stands disposed of.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
